styles.checks: Verify actual audio-node state, accurate controls, zero autoplay, bounded gain and cleanup. The scope must correspond to the signal rather than decorative random motion, and mobile must preserve the complete control set.
styles.art: The audio and scope are generated locally. Use original synthesis and scene code; do not import the reference's samples, private project state or brand identity.

styles.name: A shared rhythm / a living technical diagram
styles.composition: Balance a left editorial explanation with a large light drawing sheet. One small dimensional lead object dispatches to four distinct process specimens through curved routes, then resolves into a merged result and one progress strip. Use real curved vector routes, small colored packets, consistent projection, different internal specimen drawings and readable status. Avoid generic connected icons.
styles.surface: Use warm paper, precise green-gray lines, pale modeled node faces, small specimen labels and a restrained family of signal colors.
styles.behavior: Coordinate dispatch, work and return with one six-second logical clock. Move packets on actual SVG route geometry and update status only at semantic stages. Watch and Stop are explicit, the completed frame stays useful, and reduced motion presents completion immediately. The sequence illustrates a process. Do not claim actual agent work or numerical productivity results.
styles.checks: Packet positions, selected nodes, captions and progress must agree. Test stopping, replay, navigation cleanup and hidden tabs.
styles.art: Use coherent native vector geometry and one shared logical clock. The original artwork and demonstration copy are in the cited implementation.

styles.name: Vector foundry / a line can hold a world
styles.composition: Balance a large narrow serif statement with an isometric ruled wave sheet on a paper-and-blueprint surface. Frame it with a fine ground projection, specimen index, measured-looking annotation and small seal. Construct the wave from crisp continuous vector paths in a carefully proportioned 2:1-like isometric projection. The outer contour and internal rulings must derive from the same parametric surface; detail is structural rather than textured 3D decoration.
styles.surface: Use warm paper with muted blue-green line ranks, one restrained accent and enough contrast to separate contour, ruling, ground and annotation.
styles.behavior: Flat, Ripple and Surge select wave character; a continuous height control changes amplitude. Native SVG paths derive from one surface without requiring a 3D library. One phase drives motion and stops when hidden or reduced.
styles.checks: Inspect outline and ruling at maximum amplitude, motion extremes and portrait reflow. Reject broken joins, differing projections and unnecessary full SVG remounts each frame. Keep dimension-like annotations truthful to the illustration's role.
styles.art: This is an original native SVG projection. Read the shared surface equation and point projection rather than replacing the drawing with a static image.

styles.name: Thermal type / typography in heated air
styles.composition: Place a large luminous heat chamber at right on a cool gray page and bold technical type in the quiet left region. The amber opening and concentric hardware must physically explain the localized shimmer in the nearby words.
styles.surface: Build a dark titanium chamber with radial fins, fine fasteners, polished ring edges and a glowing striated ceramic opening. Carry one bounded optical field from the aperture through the adjacent image and technical headline with coherent direction and falloff. Keep the text block fixed while local details refract, and retain a crisp reduced-motion state.
styles.behavior: Start heat on entry without hover. Pointer presence may increase it slightly; Pause heat freezes the current field and Resume continues. Recompute the source from the actual image crop on resize and stop hidden or offscreen work. The original advected WebGL field samples cached artwork and headline together. Keep semantic DOM text and restore normal visibility on renderer failure. This is not a fluid simulation or general arbitrary-DOM refraction.
styles.checks: With the pointer outside the headline, both image near the heat source and type must change over time while an outside region stays stable. Inspect the source-to-text relationship on desktop and mobile; reject a hover-only wiggle. Check readable text, pause/resume, hidden state, reduced motion, failure recovery and stable texture-upload counts.
styles.art: The original engine asset is site/assets/motion/thermal-type.webp. The live effect combines that known image and the known headline into one cached texture, then samples them through a procedural heat field. It does not model an engine or solve fluid dynamics and does not support arbitrary live-DOM refraction. Keep accessible text and the original image as the clear fallback.

styles.name: Morph study / a shape for the change
styles.composition: On a warm mint field, place a large expressive heading beside a clear three-dimensional particle structure, with compact shape and formation controls below. Give the point cloud enough area, density and contrast to balance the type. Use stable point identities sampled into recognizable authored target geometries. Let distribution, overlap and density describe depth; keep text outside the rendering layer and avoid diffuse dust that loses the chosen shape.
styles.surface: Use fine deep-green points on a pale warm-mint ground, with enough contrast for the resting target at mobile size.
styles.behavior: Sphere, Current and Loop move the same particles among authored targets with restrained rotation; Formation changes how tightly they resolve. Retarget from current positions, preserve stable identities, and provide an intentional completed state for pause and reduced motion. Use an expressive editorial heading with Instrument Serif emphasis, balanced by a sans base and quiet precise controls, labels and supporting copy.
styles.checks: Compare resting targets and transitions separately. Reject an intermediate stall, abrupt stale shape, chaotic reassignment or weak mobile contrast. Test reversals, formation extremes and resource disposal.
styles.art: The targets and particle transitions are original code. Preserve point identity and authored geometry instead of importing third-party brand illustrations or source screenshots.
